svg.title: G / Workload-side PSC with Palo NSI Packet Intercept
svg.desc: Documented integration technology; exact PSC / MariaDB compatibility remains to be qualified.. Blue lines show application traffic; green dashed lines show return traffic; amber dotted lines show native health checks; gray dotted lines show resource or policy references. Purple lines show policy-directed inspection. Red lines show rejected or bypass paths. See adjacent ADR option for requirements.
